activity_summary: At dinner Judith gave the sermon in the vicar's voice. Your father said the aim was poor: a wheelwright, two weavers and a widow unroofed, and every great malt-loft in the High Street still dry. Your mother said his name once. The children kept the burned row for Thursday. You said you had not promised Quiney the shop.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the sermon home unimproved, and left the shop unpromised.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the maltsters with the trades that had burned, and the lofts that had not.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Said his name once, and then asked for the loaf.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the meat ahead of the sermon, and Thursday ahead of today.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Did the vicar, and kept the chimney for Thursday.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported that the hand had come away in the porch.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept yesterday's count, and Saturday's widow off the table.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Claimed Thursday for the row, and kept the nail.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat at the board after the walk back.

entities.name: Edmund Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat at the board with the household.

facets.activity: Heard Father say the aim was poor and took Thursday for the row

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: If the Lord meant the maltsters He has a poor aim

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: He's unroofed a wheelwright, two weavers and a widow, and left every great malt-loft in the High Street dry as a bone
